independentRerunVariability.explanation: HistGradientBoosting probabilities changed despite fixed seed and single-thread enforcement. XGBoost/CatBoost hashes were identical; logistic differences were below practical displayed precision. One near-50/50 prediction flipped.
independentRerunVariability.risk: Do not conflate the observed one-fight run variance with genuine predictive improvement.

stableFrontierV4.selectiveCaution: The v4 selected subset differs from v2 subset, so their selective percentages are not a fair winner-accuracy comparison.

finalDecision: Neither v3 nor v4 passed 2025 validation. Keep the existing historical Frontier v2 research output and immutable pre-event forecasts. Do not use run-to-run randomness or inspected 2026 diagnostics to promote a new model.
prioritizedNextSteps: Freeze one trusted fitted model version and training-data hashes; do not retrain opportunistically before every event.
Score previously frozen 21 November fight predictions only against individually verified completed results.
Collect fresh truly prospective event cohorts; investigate stronger new predictive features and calibration after enough independent observations.
Keep actual executable odds and wagering returns in separate verified private records if desired.
